name: 광휘집정관 솔베인
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a replacement game boss illustration for an ORIGINAL character, not the same character with minor edits. Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for composition, drawing treatment, framing and luminous atmosphere.
Keep the broad illustration layout: landscape 5:4 composition, single mature male commander seated frontally in the center of a throne, full figure including shoes, knees spread, forearms brought together over his lap; throne fills the middle, curling golden light occupies the lower corners; uncluttered pale background. Maintain bold clean 2D anime line work, controlled cel-shading, readable small-card silhouettes. Do not turn it into a realistic 3D armored knight or a portrait crop.
New character: SOLVEIN, a dark-skinned silver-haired light magistrate in his late fifties, square calm face, clean-shaven, no glasses. Short naturally flowing swept silver hair, NOT the reference face or hair. Wear a high-neck charcoal ceremonial tunic with a broad asymmetrical brass breastplate, amber glass forearm bracers, black knee boots, and a short split ochre mantle fastened at the chest. No striped suit, tie, white marine coat, epaulettes, military hat, logos or franchise emblems. Redesign the throne as a rectangular ivory-and-brass prism dais with angular layered arms and a circular amber inset behind his shoulders, NOT the reference ornate curled throne. Golden light forms thin faceted ribbons around his feet and hands. He is a dignified relaxed light sorcerer, not a copy of a specific admiral.
All visible character, costume, furniture and magical motif details must be newly designed and rendered. Preserve only the general seated framing, weight and anime illustrative feel. No copied pixels, tracing, watermark, signature, text, border, UI or numerals. Natural hand anatomy, natural head/torso proportions, no horizontal compression, no segmented plastic hair. Opaque pale background. One finished landscape 5:4 illustration.
referenceRole: Composition, framing, illustrative treatment and broad atmosphere only; never existing character identity.
